# Carcis Autobody Repair — Full Reference

## Overview

Carcis Autobody Repair is a certified auto body repair shop located at 1520 Washington St, Vancouver, Washington 98660. The shop opened in 2026 and is owned and operated by Carlos Carrasco Cisneros and Kayla Carrasco Cisneros. Carcis handles collision repair, dent and panel repair, rust repair, standard and custom paint work, and custom body work for vehicles ranging from daily drivers to classic cars. The shop serves customers going through insurance claims as well as customers paying out of pocket, and offers 10% off all work through February 14, 2027.

## Services

### Dent Repair
Removal of dings and dents from vehicle body panels. The goal is a clean finish with no visible trace of the original damage, restoring the panel to its factory-smooth appearance.

### Panel Repair
Repair or replacement of damaged body panels (doors, fenders, quarter panels, hoods, bumpers) to factory fit and alignment. Panels that cannot be repaired to spec are replaced rather than patched.

### Rust Repair
Rust removal and panel restoration, including work on classic and older vehicles. This is a specialty area for Carcis; rust repair on older cars requires different technique than modern unibody repair, and Carlos has direct experience with rust work on classic cars specifically.

### Collision Repair
Structural and cosmetic repair following a vehicle collision, ranging from minor fender-benders to major accident damage. Carcis works directly with insurance companies on collision claims and also serves customers paying for repairs themselves. Carlos has experience rebuilding vehicles that were declared a total loss.

### Paint
Full and partial vehicle paint jobs, color-matched to the vehicle's original factory paint code.

### Custom Paint & Design
One-off custom paint jobs and design work built around what the customer specifically wants, rather than a standard factory-match repaint. This includes custom color work and paint designs.

### Custom Body Work
Body modification and repair work beyond standard factory-spec repair, for vehicle builds that need something specific done to them.

## Who Carcis serves

Carcis Autobody Repair works with the general public in and around Vancouver, Washington, including the greater Vancouver/Portland metro area. Customers fall into two main groups: those filing an insurance claim after a collision or other damage, and those paying for repair work out of pocket. Both groups are served the same way, with a free estimate and straightforward pricing.

## About the owners

Carlos Carrasco Cisneros is the owner and a certified auto body technician. He trained specifically in auto body repair and holds certification in the trade. Since completing his training, Carlos has worked on routine dent and panel repair, full custom paint designs, total-loss vehicle rebuilds, and rust repair on classic cars. His background in custom paint and design work distinguishes Carcis from body shops that only handle standard insurance-spec repairs.

Kayla Carrasco Cisneros co-owns and helps run the business, handling day-to-day operations alongside Carlos.

## Why a newly opened shop

Carcis opened recently, which the owners treat as an advantage rather than a limitation: a newer shop has not yet built up the backlog that slows down long-established competitors, so turnaround times tend to be faster. Customers deal directly with the owners rather than a front-desk employee relaying information from a technician, which the shop positions as more direct communication throughout the repair process.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does Carcis work with insurance companies?**
Yes. Carcis handles both insurance-claim repairs and personal-pay repairs using the same estimate and repair process. Customers do not need to have already gone through their insurer before requesting an estimate.

**Is the estimate free?**
Yes, estimates are free. Customers can book a free estimate appointment directly through the Carcis website, which opens a calendar for picking a specific date and time.

**Does Carcis do custom paint work, or only standard repairs?**
Both. Carcis does standard factory-color-matched paint and repair work as well as fully custom paint designs and custom body work for owners who want something specific done to their vehicle, not just a repair back to stock.

**Does Carcis work on older or classic cars?**
Yes. Rust repair on classic and older vehicles is one of the shop's specialties, distinct from repair work aimed only at late-model vehicles still under manufacturer paint programs.

**What areas does Carcis serve?**
Carcis is based in Vancouver, Washington, and serves the surrounding Vancouver/Portland metro area.

**What are the shop's hours?**
Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm.

**Is there a current promotion?**
Yes. Carcis is offering 10% off all work through February 14, 2027.

## How to request an estimate

Estimates are booked directly on the Carcis website through an online calendar (the Get an Estimate page). Customers pick an available time slot and answer a few short questions about the vehicle (year, make, model), what kind of work is needed (dent, panel, rust, collision, paint, custom paint, or custom body work), and whether the repair is going through insurance or being paid for directly. The booking is confirmed automatically and syncs to the shop's calendar.
